description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/rates/policy (base $0.005; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET with no parameters (all 7 banks), or ?banks=fed,ecb,boe; add allow_partial=true to accept a charged partial answer. Current policy rates from 7 central banks in one call: Fed target range, ECB, BoE, BoC, RBA, RBNZ and Riksbank, each with its date and source link. Values are taken from each bank's own website, where they are published free of charge; the fee covers the multi-bank lookup, and no restrictions are added. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any central bank. Information only, not advice. Charged only when every requested bank is delivered, unless allow_partial=true. USDC on Base or Polygon.
